title: ASTRAZENECA FOUNDATION AWARDS OVER $1.1M IN GRANTS TO EXPAND HEALTHCARE ACCESS IN COMMUNITIES ACROSS THE U.S.
A grant isn’t always the right tool: The case for program-related investments
body: Is philanthropy using all the tools in its toolbox to drive social change? Program-related investments, which allow foundations to deploy loans, equity, and other repayable capital for charitable purposes, can provide regenerative capital that benefits nonprofits and helps foundations expand their reach. Yet only a small fraction of foundations use them.
